commonRentalAliases: GMC Sierra 1500 Denali Crew Cab or similar

cargoZones.label: Open cargo bed — short box (Crew Cab 147.4 in wheelbase)
cargoZones.notes: Uses the wheel-house width as the conservative rectangular width so rigid luggage is not planned through the wider floor sections. The open pickup bed is weather-exposed unless a cover/cap is fitted.

cargoZones.label: Open cargo bed — short box full floor width
cargoZones.notes: Alternate planning envelope that uses the full bed floor width. Wheel wells interrupt this width, so it should be treated as optimistic for rigid bags.

cargoZones.label: Open cargo bed — standard box (Crew Cab 157 in wheelbase)
cargoZones.notes: Uses the wheel-house width as the conservative rectangular width. GMC lists Crew Cab cargo volume as 62.9–71.7 cu ft depending on short or standard bed.

cargoZones.label: Rear cabin floor / seat overflow
cargoZones.notes: Generic interior overflow area for soft bags when rear seating is sacrificed; not a manufacturer cargo specification.

seatConfigurations.label: Crew cab, short bed
seatConfigurations.notes: Assumes the common Denali Crew Cab short-box configuration; cargo is exposed to weather without a bed cover.

seatConfigurations.label: Crew cab, short bed full floor width
seatConfigurations.notes: Optimistic width view for soft bags or loads that can sit around wheel wells.

seatConfigurations.label: Crew cab, standard bed
seatConfigurations.notes: For the less common Crew Cab standard-box configuration on the 157 in wheelbase.

seatConfigurations.label: Short bed with rear cabin overflow
seatConfigurations.notes: Assumes rear passenger seating is used for additional soft luggage.
